description: Reports what the context files cost the agent: bytes, lines, words and an estimate of tokens at four characters each, and when each is read, at every session with the files a CLAUDE.md imports, or only when used, as a skill, the note of a folder or a scoped rule is, the cost at every session first; how much each grew since an earlier commit, the one thirty days ago unless `since` names another; and the paragraphs of twelve words or more written in two places. It measures and counts; nothing here is a finding. Nothing is written.

repo.description: Path to the git repository. Defaults to the current working directory of the server.

since.description: The commit or branch to compare sizes with. Omit for the commit thirty days ago, or the first commit of a younger repository.

targets.description: Markdown files or folders to check, relative to the repository. Omit to auto-detect CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, installed SKILL.md files and the rest.

name: prumo_budget
